svg.aria-label: An invoice's page made from the Orbit invoice template, with its parts outlined: the letterhead, the total and the footer are locked; the customer, the number, the dates, the lines and the note are open fields.
svg.text: Text that matches INV-0000, and two dates
A name and one to four address lines
1 to 40: a description, a quantity, a price
Locked: the template adds it up
Locked: on every page, with its number
